researcher.description: Rank one to twenty titles. With corpus=hn: the verified active HN title model, fitted-sample percentiles and validation metadata. With venue (and optional track) instead of corpus: compare titles, with optional parallel abstracts, to that venue stored accepted items (needs at least 10, for example added with add_corpus_items). Under venue_comparison each candidate has a meaning section (primary, and the order of candidates): cosine similarity of local sentence embeddings of the title plus abstract, the 5 nearest accepted items, and the percentile of the nearest similarity among accepted items; meaning.computed=false with a reason when the embedder is unavailable. The embedding model (BAAI/bge-small-en-v1.5) runs locally with no Jev or paid call; first use of a venue embeds and caches its accepted items, so that call is slower. Secondary lexical output: word-overlap neighbours and percentiles, title length and shape percentiles, vocabulary overlap, accepted items per year, and a list of what was not computed. With piece (one title and a non-empty abstract), the run is also saved on that piece's rankings and run_id is returned. Meaning is similarity to past accepted work, not acceptance odds. Neither path invents abstracts or calls Jev; both log titles and scores to the rank log.
researcher.name: rank_titles
researcher.title: Compare titles

researcher.description: Read one corpus item's metadata and, when the private text store has it, one Markdown section (default _full, capped per response). Third-party text is private and shown only to authenticated agents. When text is absent or the store is unavailable the result has status unavailable with a reason and the outline of sections that do exist; no text is invented and no public copy is substituted.
researcher.name: read_item
researcher.title: Read a corpus item

researcher.description: Read one direct public HTTPS HTML/plain-text page (1 MiB) or PDF (10 MiB), with robots and network protection, no redirects, login, paywall bypass, ingestion or retained downloads. Whole read is bounded to 45 seconds; PDF extraction to 30 seconds, 100 pages and 8 MiB text, with no decryption or OCR. Returns untrusted text, extractor provenance and up to 100 HTML link metadata records, never fetches links. offset/limit count Unicode characters; limit defaults to 12000, max 24000. Each pagination call refetches; compare text_sha256 and pass expected_text_sha256 to reject changed text. content_sha256 hashes the raw body; source_pdf_sha256 hashes raw PDF bytes. Does not verify call requirements or licenses.
researcher.name: read_public_source
researcher.title: Read a public source page or PDF

researcher.description: Search Mongo-backed pieces, venues, accepted-paper metadata, and facts. Paper metadata uses native whole-word OR search in titles and abstracts; double quotes require a phrase and minus excludes a word, without stemming. Other scopes retain their own matching. Results are bounded.
researcher.name: search
researcher.title: Search

researcher.description: Search the imported corpus by title and abstract metadata only. With venue set, q may be empty to browse all its stored items in bounded pages. mode=words (default) is native whole-word search: several words match any of them, double quotes require a phrase, a leading minus excludes a word, no stemming. mode=meaning is not supported and returns status unsupported; it never falls back to words. venue accepts a registry or corpus key. The read depth on each item is a label copied from source metadata, not proof that text is stored; use read_item to find out. Pass next_cursor back with the same filters to continue.
researcher.name: search_corpus
researcher.title: Search accepted-work metadata

researcher.description: Search the venue registry by name or key, with optional tier (1-3), lane (a track's workflow lane) and applying filters. Lists every scholarly grade unless narrowed. Returns bounded venue summaries with their tracks and an opaque next_cursor; pass it back with the same filters to continue.
researcher.name: search_venues
researcher.title: Search venues
